title: 第5章 萧凡实力大涨第6章 毒士独到分析
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
萧凡在接待完两个召唤人物后，
便如饥似渴地呼唤筒子，
心中默念打开，黑麒麟的个人信息面板如画卷般徐徐展开！
一连串关于黑麒麟的个人资料，映入萧凡的眼帘，
【姓名：黑麒麟】，
【职业：刺客】，
【来历：武侠世界，秦时明月】，
【称号：千变莫名，墨玉麒麟】，
【功法：百变神行功】，
【修为：大宗师后期】，
【武器：千变匕首】，
【其他：百变领域二重天】，
【绝技：易容术】，
【忠诚度：100%】，
【评价：武侠秦时明月中的神秘杀手，被称为“月黑风冷，索命无形，千变莫名，墨玉麒麟”，精通易容术，暗夜中刺客、易容之王！】，
在看完黑麒麟的个人数据后，
萧凡也是心满意足，虽然没有带来意想不到的惊喜。
可这黑麒麟的特殊能力却让他有了一些突破常理的想法。
罢了，日后再议吧！
还是先看一看后面召唤的这个孤傲男人的个人信息面板！

默念，一连串关于叶孤城的个人资料如潮水般涌现在萧凡的眼前，
【姓名：叶孤城】，
【职业：剑客】，
【来历：武侠世界，陆小凤传奇】，
【称号：剑圣】，
【功法：神剑诀】，
【修为：天人大圆满】，
【武器：飞虹】，
【其他：剑之领域三重天圆满，领悟出了一丝剑之洞天的雏形】，
【绝技：天外飞仙】，
【忠诚度：100%】，
【评价：武侠陆小凤传奇的剑道巅峰高手，人称“白云城主”，“剑圣”，叶孤城对剑的痴迷犹如飞蛾扑火，且天资聪颖，在白云城中领悟剑道，练成“天外飞仙”绝技，凭借这一招绝技更是威震天下，其剑法堪称举世无双。】
“哇塞！”
好一个孤傲的男人，其修为境界之高，简直令人瞠目结舌！
他从原身六皇子的记忆中得知，“在这片广袤的大陆上，武道境界犹如层级分明的阶梯，共分为九个等级。
content_en:
After Xiao Fan received the two summoned characters,
Then he called for the tube hungrily,
Opening it with silent thoughts in his heart, Black Qilin's personal information panel slowly unfolded like a scroll!
A series of personal information about Black Qilin came into Xiao Fan's eyes.
[Name: Black Kirin],
[Occupation: Assassin],
[Origin: Martial Arts World, Qin Shi Mingyue],
[Title: Thousands of Inexplicable Changes, Black Jade Unicorn],
[Kung Fu: All-Changing Divine Power],
[Cultivation: late stage of Grand Master],
[Weapon: Thousand-Change Dagger],
[Others: Second Heaven in the Variety Field],
[Special Skill: Disguise],
[Loyalty: 100%],
[Evaluation: The mysterious killer in the martial arts Qin Shi Ming Yue is known as "the moon is dark and cold, the life is invisible, the changes are inexplicable, the black jade unicorn", proficient in the art of disguise, the assassin in the dark night, the king of disguise! ],
After reading Hei Qilin’s personal data,
Xiao Fan was also satisfied, although it did not bring any unexpected surprises.
But the special ability of this black unicorn gave him some ideas that broke through common sense.
That’s it, let’s discuss it later!
Let’s take a look at the personal information panel of the aloof man summoned later!
Thinking silently, a series of personal information about Ye Gucheng appeared in front of Xiao Fan like a tide.
[Name: Ye Gucheng],
[Occupation: Swordsman],
[Origin: Martial Arts World, Legend of Lu Xiaofeng],
[Title: Sword Master],
[Kung Fu: Divine Sword Technique],
[Cultivation: Great Perfection of Heaven and Man],
[Weapon: Feihong],
[Others: The third level of the Sword Realm is complete, and a trace of the prototype of the Sword Cave Heaven is realized],
[Special Skill: Flying Immortal from Beyond the Sky],
[Loyalty: 100%],
[Evaluation: Lu Xiaofeng, the legendary master of swordsmanship in the martial arts world, is known as the "Lord of Baiyun City" and "Sword Master". Ye Gucheng's obsession with swords is like a moth to a flame, and he is very talented. He learned the way of swordsmanship in Baiyun City and practiced the "Flying Immortal from Heaven" stunt. With this unique skill, he is even more powerful in the world, and his swordsmanship is unparalleled in the world. 】
"Wow!"
What an aloof and arrogant man, his cultivation level is so high that it is simply jaw-dropping!
He learned from the memory of his original sixth prince, “In this vast continent, the realm of martial arts is like a ladder with distinct levels, divided into nine levels.
